annotations.title: Pensions in inheritance tax from April 2027

description: What the April 2027 change does to a pension left behind: inheritance tax with the pension outside the estate (the rules before 6 April 2027) and inside it (from then on), the beneficiary's income tax, and what reaches them. Use for 'what happens to my pension when I die from 2027'.

beneficiaryMarginalRatePct.description: The beneficiary's own marginal income tax rate, e.g. 40. Defaults to 20.

diesBefore75.description: Death before 75, so the beneficiary pays no income tax on it. Defaults to false.

estateExcludingPension.description: Everything except the pension - property, ISAs, savings - in pounds.

qualifiesForResidenceBand.description: The home passes to children or grandchildren. Defaults to false.

transferredNilRateBand.description: Married or civil partnered, with a transferred nil-rate band. Defaults to false.
